notes.title: Fixes! 1.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]ai now has a beacon, you can see where it is
[*]Fixed a bug where the dungeon wouldn't be on for the ai
[*]Fixed a bug with quiting to start from practice
[*]Polished the spells and optimized them
[*]Optimized the scene even further
[*]Didn't realize my settings weren't saving so those are now set from start improving performance!
[*]Card size preference is now saved and loads automatically
[*]Removed a post process that wasn't needed
[*]Don't know if I covered it yet but the mana system is cool, just find a crystal and it'll restock either your preservation or action cards.
[/list]

Been a busy weekend! I've had a complaint about the ai constantly tracking you being difficult, but it's waaay too easy if it doesn't and the effort to get it much smarter just isn't worth it at this time. The beacon does an excellent job and makes it a bit easier. Remember to use your preservation cards!

The ai constantly knows where you are, but can only hit you with a damage card if it can see you directly. 
Good luck!

notes.title: Paper Mage Updates
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I haven’t posted in a while but I wanted to let everyone know that doesn’t mean I haven’t been hard at work chipping away at progress.

BTW, the header and cover image of this announcement is what the navmesh looks like for the ai pathfinding. Pretty cool.

The game is still set to release in July, but there have been some changes in my plan. Please see below:

[h1]Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Adding in key rebinding
[*]The reapplication for the mega grant is on hold
[*]Achievements are removed.
[*]Card Unlocking has been removed.
[*]Accessory unlocking has been removed
[*]Simple ai in practice mode is done!
[*]Grappling Improved and optimized.
[*]Swimming improved and optimized.
[*]Optimization is complete. (More on that later)
[/list]

Unfortunately, I had to find a creative way to make it worth my effort to sink more time into it, and the complexities of tracking player levels based on wins, unlocking cards based on level, and unlocking accessories is just way out of the realm of realistic for me (along with configuring achievements). 

[h2]Here is how the game is impacted:[/h2]

[list]
[*]It gets to be released in July!
[*]Also, at a cheaper price than I initially planned.
[*]I will create new cards periodically and pushed them as updates to the game, and everyone will have them available in their deck to be randomly drawn.
[*]The same goes for accessories, though those are currently much lower priority.
[*]The other races will also be created and released periodically.
[*]As the collection of cards grows and nears completion, the game’s purchase price will increase slightly. Early players are rewarded in that sense.
[/list]

[h2]How is it different than the demo?[/h2]

The official game will have all of the cards that the demo does, and more. The demo will only ever contain the cards it currently has. 

Thanks for bearing with me, as a solo developer (with significant early help with networking with Ramon Marrero) it's incredibly difficult to juggle such an ambitious game with all of my other responsibilities, but dang I love this game.

I can’t wait to get this more polished update pushed to the demo and released as the main game.

I’ll update you all again soon.

David

notes.title: Added A New Race to Paper Mages
notes.content:
Development is still going strong for Paper Mages!
The Borxen race has been implemented
(as seen in the playful Smash Bros Esque reveal image)

The game has been updated a lot and the screens on the store page could use some updating.

Updates:
Added the Borxen
Added stars
Added dynamic cloud system
Fixed Fish shader and swimming mechanic
Implemented Cards being used - still in progress
Divided the card cast - Now instead of a click casting a spell the player can hold the spell and release when ready.
Added a cool down to the spell use time (1.5 seconds or so)
Added post process to water in main area
AND the 20 cards used in the demo are all basically complete!
There are a few visual tweaks but everything works!
Fixed Double Jump mechanic
Fixed exponential fall feature
Polished gameplay
Optimization

Began deeper levels of optimization
Began work on the start menu scene
Began extra optimization on Master Matierals using Custom Data

Hopefully the demo will stay on track for late April-May

There is a video on the youtube page:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r9edlLpQ9dg

The next devlog will be up this week. We'll make an announcement when it's up as well.

Thanks!

David
